glossary.definition: As used in this section, "money market investment" means any investment sold under that name or a variant thereof, and any pool of interest-bearing securities in which rights of participation in the distribution of such interest on a pro rata basis are sold by whatever name is used with a promise that they will be repurchased or their principal value otherwise redeemed, with or without the deduction of a fee, by the seller or a contractually specified person, without the requirement of a waiting period other than a reasonable time for the transfer of such funds.
glossary.source_title: Section 5711.341 - List of investors in money market investment to be filed with tax commissioner.
